summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The iShares Morningstar Value ETF (ILCV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index of value stocks, selected from the top 90% of the US market-cap spectrum. ILCV was launched on Jun 28, 2004 and is issued by BlackRock.
infoTable: Morningstar US Large-Mid Cap Broad Value Index

holdings.infoBox: ILCV is an equity ETF with a total of 377 individual holdings. The top holdings are Microsoft stock at 8.37%, Apple at 7.24%, Alphabet at 4.58%, Amazon.com at 3.21%, and Meta Platforms at 2.95%.
